title: The Wedding Photo Erased Me
premise: A man's wedding photograph erases him, his wife forgets him, and his body vanishes into the glass. The final line reveals that he cut another man from this same photograph the night before.
hook: Our wedding photo erased me. My wife was still there, but I was gone. She stared at me. “Who are you?”
